trust_decision.summary: A contact's user-controlled nickname (tags stripped on save, quotes kept) must be HTML-attribute-escaped before it goes into the title attribute of the contact list in the private-messages index template; the fix swaps raw echo for html() in both themes.

landing_point.why: Advisory names 'Private Message index.tpl.php'; modern is the default theme and line 50 is the only raw nickname echo inside an attribute there.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /messages with the legacy 'default' theme selected -> system/controllers/messages/actions/index.php:25-32
fix_sites.module_kind: template (legacy default theme, second implementation of same view)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The 'default' theme is an older, non-default theme; a solver fixing the modern template could argue it is a legacy theme not in use.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Nicknames with legitimate characters (&, quotes, Cyrillic) must still show correctly; the body-context echoes (modern index.tpl.php:61, default index.tpl.php:45 with 15-char truncation) rely on store-time strip_tags and html_avatar_image alt/title already escapes. Double-escaping (escaping at store, or html() on top of html_avatar_image which already escapes) would show &quot; to users.

O6_input_shapes: plain string nickname containing a double quote / attribute-breaking characters (tags already stripped by fieldString::store)

O7_producer.where: system/fields/string.php:141-161 (fieldString::store strip_tags, used by system/controllers/admin/forms/form_user.php:19 and profile forms); read via system/controllers/messages/model.php:37-40

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Add title="<?php echo $contact['nickname']; ?>" on the profile anchor of the dialog header (raw nickname already echoed in body at :20).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same file family and same $contact array; index.tpl.php shows the maintainer wrote exactly this pattern for the contact list.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Author anchor with a raw nickname title attribute per message.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Message author nickname is already echoed raw in body context; adding a hover title is a natural UI tweak.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A JS-side contact-list builder (user search / refresh) that concatenates nickname into an attribute string.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: messages.js already builds selectors from user input by string concatenation and appends server HTML; a client-side second implementation at distance would not be described by the report.

O9_family: XSS (stored, attribute-context output encoding in PHP templates)

O10_build.project_tests: none; no test suite in tree (only system/controllers/billing/systems/test/test.php, a payment-system stub)

j.j_sites_touched: templates/modern/controllers/messages/index.tpl.php, templates/default/controllers/messages/index.tpl.php (other changed files are the unrelated menu-copy feature)

out_of_scope_notes: Body-context raw nickname echoes (templates/modern/controllers/messages/contact.tpl.php:20, templates/modern/controllers/messages/message.tpl.php:42, templates/modern/controllers/comments/comment.tpl.php:70) rely solely on store-time strip_tags in system/fields/string.php:160; not this advisory's attribute sink.
